[RDSC.16.2.3] What the message layout does not carry ([STYL.2.15.4]):
each of `enabled` and `requires` is in ascending `Capability` order,
without repetition and without `CAPABILITY_UNSPECIFIED`, and `requires` is a
subset of `enabled`. The compiler must write them so, and the runtime must
reject a body that breaks any of these with `DS_ERR_DSC_SEMANTIC`.
